verdict.rationale: Simular documents a Sai REST API, a Python SDK and an MCP server that let developers drive an autonomous computer from their own code. Concrete endpoints are listed for streaming events, answering approvals and listing machines, and plain-language tasks run on a cloud Windows computer. The OpenAPI probe 404s only show no machine-readable spec is published at the probed paths; they do not contradict the API claims. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API/SDK, a published OpenAPI spec, and evidence that the API can target BYOD devices as well as cloud machines.
